svg.aria-label: Queue versus stream: in a message queue each message goes to one worker and is deleted once acknowledged; in an event stream like Kafka messages stay in an ordered log and each consumer group reads at its own offset, so many consumers can read and replay the same events.
svg.title: Queue versus stream: in a message queue each message goes to one worker and is deleted once acknowledged; in an event stream like Kafka messages stay in an ordered log and each consumer group reads at its own offset, so many consumers can read and replay the same events.
svg.text: each message to one worker; deleted on ack
